item.title: Goal remains the same as HVAC project list changes for upcoming bond issue
item.description: Fred Van Ranken, superintendent of Newton USD 373, knows people might get a bit nervious abotu makiing changes to a proposed bond issue — a thought that gave him pause as he asked for an audit of sorts of district HVAC needs and a project list created in the run-up to the creation of a bond issue to be voted on in March.

item.title: Vote clarified for 2026 fireworks season
item.description: The Newton Kansan reported Jan. 28 at thekansan.com a motion to limit fireworks sales and discharge to four days in 2026 carried 3-2, with Jason Miller, Kathy Valentine and Melanie Watson voting in favor. Leory Koehn and Richard Stinnett voted against.
